interpolation.exact: Linear interpolation between start/end values; clamp to end at or after end iteration.

objective.exact: sample_z1, reconstruction+beta*selected_regularizer+separate optional variance penalties; do not copy those extra penalties.

normalization.author_code: KL sums latent dimensions then averages examples. Shifted reconstruction CE averages non-PAD token targets (ignore_index=PAD).
normalization.H5: Both reconstruction CE over all48 positions and conditional prior density difference divide by B*48; latent shape16*48 and native conditional prior differ.
normalization.consequence: Author numerical beta.03 is not H5 beta.03 in effective regularization. Keeping final H5 beta1 isolates schedule within H5; warmup transfer is a declared method adaptation, not quantitative reproduction.

admission_before_training.current_frozen_route: Current encoder q is diagonalGaussian, no posteriorflow; M=decode(mu), S=decode(mu+exp(logsigma)*epsilon). prior_flow(z,g) is used only in density objective; g/h enter encoder, decoder has no g/teacher forcing.
admission_before_training.if_not_triggered: Do not train the candidate, do not enlargeK or choose seeds to force gate. Preserve no-trigger/incomplete finding.

only_candidate.schedule: zero-based update u=0..999; beta(u)=min(1,u/200). u0..199 ramp, u200..999 beta1. No second beta endpoint and no variance penalty.
only_candidate.control: Frozen current CE21 beta1 VAE1000 from same initialization/shuffle/forward RNG; reused historical control explicitly identified. No new control replicas claimed.
only_candidate.coupling: init222,shuffle222,VAE noise222, same batch order/sizes, identical stochastic call counts/order; altered stochastic parameters may alter sampled z values but same base random draws must be verifiable. Bind old checkpoint/scaler/config hashes before any execution.

primary_hypothesis_and_failure.hypothesis: At the fixed1000 endpoint, this single schedule intervention improves mean per-sequence expected stochastic nonPAD reconstruction on dev41 relative to frozen constant-beta1 and shrinks the M−S accuracy gap.
primary_hypothesis_and_failure.primary_quantity: mean_i mean_k accuracy_nonPAD(S_ik,x_i); training and each terminal are reported separately; persequence mean is not AA macro or residue micro.
primary_hypothesis_and_failure.minimum_effect_for_further_investment: At least5pp higher dev mean stochastic accuracy than constant-beta1, AND smaller dev M−S gap. This planned practical threshold is not significance; both raw changes retained.
failure: Any incomplete/nonfinite/route or coupling failure => invalid experiment, retainallslots; no automatic retry.
Failure of either planned primary condition => no evidence to fund downstream DDPM under this hypothesis. Mean-only reconstruction improvement is insufficient.
Warmup cannot be called successful globally if rare-class recall/macro/length/exact or train-to-dev disparity worsens: report tradeoff, even if primary trigger passes.
Posterior/prior-density or scale deterioration is a side effect, not silently dismissed. Better stochastic reconstruction does not establish aggregate-prior match or generation benefit.
